integrity: Self-contained finite certificate in verify.cpp. Two independently constructed exact methods compare all 4,194,304 ordered coset pairs state by state; no floating-point assumptions. Scientific novelty is subject to residual literature access risk. No independent validation or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive classification only for binary RM(1,4) with two ordered rows and the joint union-support distance; it establishes neither an infinite-family formula nor the symmetry-orbit decomposition of farthest coset pairs. Some relevant full texts were inaccessible.
title: Exact two-query coset-distance spectrum of the binary four-variable first-order Reed–Muller code
